triage.kind_span: Tekla World Healthcare Fund (the "Trust") is issuing non-transferable rights ("Rights") to its Shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 8, 2021

subject_names.span: Tekla World Healthcare Fund (the "Trust") is issuing

subject_tickers.span: New York Stock Exchange Symbol: THW

security_class.span: These Rights will allow you to subscribe for one (1) common share of beneficial interest

rights_per_share.span: You will receive one Right for each whole Share that you hold of record as of the Record Date

rights_per_new_share.span: The Rights entitle a Shareholder to acquire, at the Subscription Price, one Share for every three Rights held.

price_reference.span: will be determined based upon a formula equal to 95% of the volume weighted average price of a Share on the NYSE

price_pct.span: will be determined based upon a formula equal to 95% of the volume weighted average price of a Share on the NYSE

price_floor_pct_nav.span: If, however, the Formula Price is less than 90% of the NAV per Share at the close of trading on the NYSE on the Expiration Date (as defined below), then the Subscription Price will be 90% of the Trust's NAV per Share

record_date.span: to its Shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 8, 2021

expiration_date.span: which starts on March 16, 2021 and ends at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time on April 6, 2021

transferable.span: The Rights are non-transferable, which means that the Rights may not be purchased or sold

over_subscription.span: If you exercise all of the Rights issued to you, you may subscribe for Shares which were not otherwise subscribed for by others in the Primary Subscription.

max_new_shares.span: to its Shareholders non-transferable Rights to subscribe for an aggregate of 10,077,635 Shares

notes: Final 424B1 prospectus dated March 4, 2021. Subscription price = 95% of the NYSE VWAP on the expiration date and the four preceding trading days, floored at 90% of NAV per share at the close on the expiration date; recorded as price_reference 'market', price_pct 95, price_floor_pct_nav 90 (the effective price is the greater of the two legs). Estimated Subscription Price $17.00 (as of February 26, 2021). Subscription period March 16 to April 6, 2021, 5:00 p.m. ET, unless extended; only one expiration date is stated. max_new_shares excludes the discretionary increase of up to 25% (an additional 2,519,409 shares, aggregate 12,597,044) used to honour over-subscription requests. Offer announced before the open on January 11, 2021. The Investment Adviser paragraph says the adviser 'also serves as investment adviser to Tekla World Healthcare Fund ("THW")', which looks like a drafting slip.
